story: There’s No Such Thing as Clean Code
text: There's a good take on this by Casey Muratori - [VIDEO] And I agree with him. Things like SOLID and "Clean Code" really are just buzzwords nowadays that don't mean anything.

> Additionally I think SOLID principles should be part of every (software) engineer’s skills repertoire. No. I don't agree with Casey Muratori on a lot of things, but he hits the nail on the head about that statement in this video (around 23:00, but I'd suggest you watch the whole thing for context) - [VIDEO] I've walked out of interviews (politely) because I was asked to recite some buzzword bullshit like SOLID.

story: DRY is an over-rated programming principle?
text: I think they used that term on purpose. Non-pessimized in this case is the same as optimized, and I believe it's a reference to this video [VIDEO]
